scope.research_boundary: Audit only each exact target, its current queue attempt, and source records accepted for that attempt. Review one exact source at a time. Add source-reuse resolutions only for directly supported populated claims with source-class, generation, market, date and measurement caveats. Keep full BOM, material details, stiffness evidence, geometry, image or weight claims open where exact evidence is incomplete. No external requests or catalog edits.
excluded: No other models or atomic gaps.
No new web/public-post/seller requests or source records.
No catalog, price or image data changes.
